It is a constant reminder of Allah's ever-presentness and His unwavering attention towards His creations. The name also symbolizes the concept of tawhid, the belief in the Unity of God, as it emphasizes the idea that Allah is always present and close to us.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Mawjud" lies in its reminder of Allah's constant presence and His infinite love and mercy towards His creation. It encourages the believer to remember Allah in all aspects of life, and to seek His guidance and help in times of need. The name also symbolizes the concept of submission to Allah and the belief in His supremacy and power over all things. Ultimately, the name "Mawjud" serves as a source of inspiration and motivation for believers to strive for closer proximity to Allah and to live in accordance with His divine will.
